name: Laszlo Aranyi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: László Aranyi, who also writes as Frater Azmon, is a Hungarian poet whose work moves between poetry, visual imagination and alchemical symbolism. His contributor notes in Word For/Word identify the books (szellem)válaszok, A Nap és Holderők egyensúlya and Kiterített rókabőr. English translations have brought his work to journals including Synchronized Chaos.

In ‘Art’, published here in Gabor Gyukics’s English translation, creation becomes an unsettling experiment. A sewing machine, a dissection table and an alchemist’s cauldron turn the act of making into a struggle with power, imitation and decay. The poem’s repeated image of offspring as caricatures questions what a creator can truly bring to life.
